operator_locked_immediate_priorities: P0-A: normal nonterminal turn worktime at least 10 minutes (600 observed elapsed seconds)
P0-B: SAME MAIN final scheduler write uses full recurring VEVENT and targets observed close + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds)

active_retest.purpose: Test whether the minimal proven same-automation full-RRULE update pattern eliminates post-close overwrite and whether durable unit progress is accompanied by user-visible trace output.
active_retest.success_signal: After nonterminal close, live metadata retains SAME MAIN enabled=true with RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY and DTSTART equal to observed close + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds), no later same-wake schedule mutation occurs, and persisted bounded units produce the required compact user-visible trace.
active_retest.failure_signal: The provisional/stale due remains after close, RRULE disappears, automation is disabled/replaced, a post-final reconciliation mutates schedule again, or durable bounded-unit evidence exists without the required user-visible trace.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: The separate RRULE self-update test preserves same automation + enabled recurring RRULE while moving DTSTART. Epoch 89 explicitly advances STARTUP_ACK/CURRENT/ACTIVITY/HANDOFF together and treats chat trace delivery as a separately testable observability surface.
latest_diagnosis.implication: Keep scheduler mutation minimal and authoritative; durable state follows verified live due. Treat missing user-visible traces as observability failure rather than evidence that work did not occur.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Minimal same-automation full recurring VEVENT updates plus last-writer-wins close semantics will preserve close + 1 minute (60 seconds) due; explicit trace evidence will distinguish execution failure from chat-observability failure.
